providers.title: Comparison of the configuration programs
providers.scope: The type configuration value is at most the individual configuration value, which is at most the optimum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The counting bound
providers.scope: If every size exceeds 1/6, every configuration has at most five items and LP is at least the number of items divided by 5.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unbounded configuration gap (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every c there is an instance with sizes above 1/6 whose configuration values equal B and whose optimum exceeds B + c.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Graph-to-packing reduction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A polynomial-time map from (G, k) to 5B items: a cover of size k gives B bins; B + c bins give a cover of size k + rho n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matching by sorting
providers.scope: If every prefix has at least as many h's as z's, the sorted lists satisfy h_(j) <= z_(j).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Competing trees (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Two trees with depth quotas: each alone can be hit d times on every root-to-leaf path, but with shared quotas one has an unhit path.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Coordinate order
providers.scope: One step of position outweighs every earlier edge offset; one step of edge offset outweighs every baseline difference within the edge.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Geometry of the cells
providers.scope: Nested cells with gaps at least three widths; short intervals meet at most one cell of a depth and at most one job cell.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Scalar encoding (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Sizes in (1/6, 1); a five-item bin has primary score at most 0, zero exactly for the four patterns; good tuples fit iff their coordinates sum to at most 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Good anchors under an additive allowance (OpenAI)
providers.scope: With at most B + c bins, fewer than K items leave the patterns and fewer than 3K anchors of each label leave good tuples.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Completion and key inequalities
providers.scope: A good M tuple fits iff the completion meets the deadline; a good G tuple needs a row and a resource not later than its key.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Completeness (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A vertex cover with at most k vertices gives a packing into B bins.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fractional value for K4 (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For K4 and k = 2 both configuration programs have value exactly B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Coverage at every test point
providers.scope: In a packing into B + c bins every test point of a vertex lies in at least d - 6K completion intervals.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A large count on one side (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every vertex uses at least d - 6K length-one global items on its plus side or on its minus side.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Long matches at a job (OpenAI)
providers.scope: At a job position that is not excluded, at least d - x_v^+ - 9K keys take long rows of the same position.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Soundness (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A packing into at most B + c bins yields a vertex cover with at most k + rho n vertices.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Additive hardness (OpenAI; uses Hastad's theorem)
providers.scope: For fixed c it is NP-hard to distinguish packings into B bins from instances with no packing into B + c bins.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Additive approximation and P = NP
providers.scope: A polynomial-time algorithm within OPT + C bins exists iff P = NP (the forward direction uses Hastad's theorem).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
